aggregation: Median of the three independent JVM summaries; p95 is median of per-JVM p95, not pooled p95. Max is largest recorded sample across forks. All samples retained.

commandJ.aggregation: Median of three per-fork p50/p95/p99 and sample mean; maximum across all forks; no pooling or discarded outliers. Raw JMH histograms retained.

startup.scope: Alternating order, new JVM and fresh isolated profile, same source, warm OS caches. LaunchServices dispatch to CGWindowList observation at 20 ms polling; not physical compositor presentation or completed semantic initialization.

candidate.scope: One ten-minute CPU/RSS sample sequence per artifact (20 monotonic intervals), parent and immediate children only. Heap and GC are separate captures: deltas apply only between their own endpoints, not matched ten-minute windows. No forced GC or full JVM property dump is archived.

heap.interpretation: Independent endpoint values only; no matched-window growth or retained-memory conclusion.

gc.interpretation: No invocation/time increments were observed only between these independently captured counter endpoints.

baseline.scope: One ten-minute CPU/RSS sample sequence per artifact (20 monotonic intervals), parent and immediate children only. Heap and GC are separate captures: deltas apply only between their own endpoints, not matched ten-minute windows. No forced GC or full JVM property dump is archived.

heap.interpretation: Independent endpoint values only; no matched-window growth or retained-memory conclusion.

gc.interpretation: No invocation/time increments were observed only between these independently captured counter endpoints.

earlierBaselineIdleControl.reason: End jcmd calls failed under sandbox and owned process was then stopped; PID-header-only endpoints do not establish heap/GC state. Repeated with explicit approved endpoint capture.
